bioParagraphs: I'm a Software and Cloud Engineer with a B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering from SUST and AWS Solutions Architect certification. I combine full-stack development with TypeScript, Node.js, and React with hands-on experience in REST API design, Docker, Jenkins CI/CD, and cloud architecture.

I currently contribute to backend API development and production workflows at W3 Engineers. Previously, I spent two years at Outlier AI evaluating AI-generated code across Python, JavaScript, and C++, with a focus on quality, security, logic, and clear feedback for RLHF pipelines.
